scientific_question: Keeping the v20 trajectory-held-out lift span, keyframes, parent CNN, solver, rank grid, and compatibility gates fixed, can oracle coefficients chosen by projected-lift A-space error rather than lift-L2 error make one common numeric rank pass all five trajectories?

scope.trajectory_role: post-open fit-only leave-one-trajectory-out representation transfer diagnostic under one parent CNN trained on all five trajectories

time_contract.innovation_definition: one-step even-to-odd lift difference; all trajectories share the same physical time step

innovation_contract.exact_lift: h_t = A^T z_t from the frozen parent CNN proposal
innovation_contract.held_out_true_lift_innovation_use: oracle A-space coefficient target only; never an online input
innovation_contract.coefficient_objective: for each skipped frame, minimize ||A(mean + U_r c - exact_lift_innovation)||_2 with a minimum-norm least-squares solution
innovation_contract.formal_solver: direct float64 SVD least squares on the projected basis with rcond=eps_float64*max(2072,192)
innovation_contract.independent_solver: QR of the projected basis followed by SVD of the triangular factor at the same frozen relative cutoff

primary_family.mean: equal mean of the four fit-trajectory innovation means
primary_family.row_weight: sqrt(50) divided by each fit trajectory's centered Frobenius norm

innovation_contract.global_rank_rule: one family and one common numeric rank from 0,16,32,64,96,128,160,192 must pass all five held-out trajectories; per-trajectory best-rank composition is forbidden; effective_full is span sensitivity only and cannot produce a PASS because its resolved dimension may differ by fold
innovation_contract.rank_boundary_rule: a numeric rank greater than zero and below effective rank is eligible only when (s_r-s_{r+1})/s_1 is at least 1e-10 in every held-out fold; rank zero is eligible and effective_full remains sensitivity-only

rank_zero_meaning.trajectory_balanced_centered_lift: add the fit-only equal-trajectory mean innovation

innovation_contract.range_proof: every nonzero basis vector is formed from A^T innovation rows; their mean, span, and previous exact lift remain in Range(A^T)

mandatory_sanity_controls: the v21 private execution release binds the independently validated v20 execution release, report, independent validation, ready receipt, candidate array, Stage 1 metadata, and Stage 1 seal by SHA-256
v20 lift-L2 decision must independently validate as FAIL_PREREGISTERED_LIFT_SUBSPACE_RANKS_V20
the primary lift-L2 coefficient control is recomputed in the same sealed run at every frozen rank and must match the sealed v20 candidate array within max-absolute 1e-10
if any common numeric rank of the reproduced lift-L2 controls passes all trajectories, v21 is INVALID rather than evidence of coefficient-objective mismatch
rank-zero A-space and lift-L2 candidates are bitwise identical
for every skipped frame and rank, the A-space oracle projected residual must not exceed the paired lift-L2 control residual by more than 1e-10
normal-equation relative stationarity must be computed per skipped frame, reported as p50/p90/worst, and have worst at most 1e-10 for every nonzero A-space solve
Full-CNN Dual-K1 must pass all-frame and skipped-only gates on all five trajectories
held-out self full span must reconstruct its 50 lift innovations within relative-L2 1e-10
all-five pooled full span must reconstruct each included trajectory within relative-L2 1e-10
rank-zero raw family equals exact hold
rank-zero centered family equals fit-only mean innovation
v18 diagonal-delta and causal linear extrapolation remain reported controls
Zero-CGLS K4 remains the unchanged reconstruction reference

execution_order.stage_1: validate the frozen v20 parent artifact chain; load observations and times but do not read gauge-truth file bytes; generate all 101 parent proposals and exact lifts; fit the unchanged v20 fold bases; project each basis and held-out exact innovation through A; solve every frozen-rank A-space oracle; require paired lift-L2 candidates to reproduce the sealed v20 candidates; atomically seal candidate skipped-frame lifts
execution_order.stage_1_independent_preflight: before any gauge-truth file-byte read, a separate process must independently validate the frozen v20 parent chain, reproduce the fit basis through QR plus small SVD, reproduce A-space coefficients through QR plus triangular-factor SVD, compare paired lift-L2 controls to the sealed v20 candidates, then compare candidate lifts, diagnostics, rank eligibility, ledgers, and sealed bytes
execution_order.stage_2: only after the Stage 1 independent receipt exists, validate gauge-truth release hashes, open gauge truth, run the fixed solver, and score all candidates
execution_order.independent_validation: recompute Stage 1 without importing the formal v21 scientific helper, then independently recompute the unchanged K1 solver and all field, gradient, and observation metrics; compare predictions rather than signed basis vectors

solver_and_cost.exact_keyframe: parent proposal z -> exact h=A^T z -> observable alpha -> strict CGLS K1
solver_and_cost.skipped_frame_counterfactual: h_hat=h_previous+mean+U c -> observable alpha -> strict CGLS K1
solver_and_cost.new_v21_operator_claim_if_deployable: no additional A reduction beyond v16; 50 further A^T calls are counterfactually removed
solver_and_cost.oracle_diagnostic_actual_cost: all 101 parent proposals and exact lifts are generated and the coefficient oracle additionally uses 2500 A calls over five folds; these calls are excluded from deployment accounting and make v21 non-resource-eligible
solver_and_cost.evaluation_projection_calls: reported separately and excluded from deployment ledger

accuracy_gates.aggregation: every trajectory independently; pooled-frame rescue forbidden

decision_order: If time, parent Full-CNN Dual-K1, self-span, pooled-span, source identity, frozen v20 parent chain, paired v20 lift-L2 candidate identity/failure reproduction, or independent recomputation sanity fails, return INVALID_PARENT_OR_SANITY_V21.

If one primary-family common numeric rank passes both gates on every trajectory, return PASS_PRIMARY_A_SPACE_HEADROOM_NOT_DEPLOYABLE_V21. Together with v20 FAIL, this is evidence that the coefficient objective was mismatched, not a deployable algorithm result.

If no primary numeric rank passes but one sensitivity-family common numeric rank passes all trajectories, return PASS_SENSITIVITY_A_SPACE_REQUIRES_NEW_FREEZE_V21; it cannot authorize predictor training.

Otherwise return FAIL_PREREGISTERED_A_SPACE_LIFT_RANKS_V21. Together with v20 FAIL, this says the two frozen global linear coefficient objectives do not provide common-rank headroom; it does not close conditioned, local, nonlinear, history-aware, or direct final-metric models.

compactness_interpretation.rank_128_to_192: high-rank headroom with material basis memory and multiplication cost
compactness_interpretation.effective_full_only: span headroom without a compact representation claim
